mapper.sql: id, title, content, link_url AS linkUrl, start_time AS startTime, end_time AS endTime, status, sort, create_time AS createTime
mapper.insert: insert into fly_announcement (id, title, content, link_url, start_time, end_time, status, sort, create_time) values (#{id}, #{title}, #{content}, #{linkUrl}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{status}, #{sort}, now())
mapper.select: select from fly_announcement order by sort asc, id desc limit #{offset}, #{rows}
select from fly_announcement where status = 1 and (start_time is null or start_time <= now()) and (end_time is null or end_time >= now()) order by sort asc, id desc limit #{rows}
